TypeScript

 
 
 
 

TypeScript is a language for application-scale JavaScript. TypeScript adds optional types to JavaScript that support tools for large-scale JavaScript applications for any browser, for any host, on any OS. TypeScript compiles to readable, standards-based JavaScript. Try it out at the playground, and stay up to date via our blog and Bluesky.

There are many ways to contribute to TypeScript.

 Submit bugs and help us verify fixes as they are checked in.
 Review the source code changes.
 Engage with other TypeScript users and developers on Stack Overflow.
 Help each other in the TypeScript Community Discord.
 Join the typescript discussion on Bluesky.
 Contribute bug fixes.

install.title: Installing
install.html:
For the latest stable version:

npm install -D typescript

For our nightly builds:

npm install -D typescript@next
